confidence_notes: Beer, coffee and meal anchors come from cost-of-living aggregators with mixed dates, mostly Naha-specific or Okinawa-wide, so they are medium quality. Cocktail and wine are inferred from the beer relationship and from Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka hotel-bar menus, so they are weaker. All four accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season; I did not check booking pages or current listings. The only official rba.gov.au observation I could surface is dated 2026-03-20, which is stale. Later non-RBA quotes around 0.70 were not used, so verify against the RBA table before relying on this rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to Naha-specific and Okinawa-prefecture cost-of-living figures for beer, coffee and meals. Tokyo, Kyoto and Osaka hotel-bar menus were used as upper-bound references for cocktail and wine. Accommodation is set against typical summer-peak pricing in other mid-sized Japanese regional tourist cities.
